raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "In-plane aspect ratio of the modeled half-beam",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2 refers to Fig. 1(a) for the domain. Sec. 3.4 gives element counts and a radius relative to the maximum length, but not the second physical span. In the readings, L and H are the half-domain spans, with x=0 chosen as the symmetry cut and y=0 as the bottom.",
      "readings": [
        "L/H = 3",
        "L/H = 2*sqrt(3)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Exact exterior boundary of the half-domain",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The domain is identified through Fig. 1(a); the text does not specify whether its boundary is an ideal rectangle or follows the hexagonal mesh perimeter.",
      "readings": [
        "Straight-edged rectangular domain",
        "Nominally rectangular domain with a stepped perimeter formed by complete hexagons"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Physical bearing location and footprint",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2 assigns boundary conditions to Fig. 1(a). Sec. 3.2 mentions fixeddofs on line 37 without giving their indices or coordinates.",
      "readings": [
        "One supported node at the lower outer corner (L,0)",
        "One supported node inset along the bottom at (0.9L,0)",
        "A supported bottom-edge patch spanning 0.95L <= x <= L"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "Displacement constraints at the physical bearing",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 2 nor Sec. 3.2 states which displacement components are restrained at the physical bearing; the base-case fixeddofs assignment is absent.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical roller: uy=0, ux free; impose normal-displacement symmetry on the cut",
        "Pin: ux=uy=0; impose normal-displacement symmetry on the cut"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "External load F",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2 refers to Fig. 1(a) for F. Sec. 3.2 explains sparse-force assembly but omits the base-case row indices, so no application coordinates are supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "At the upper symmetry-cut corner (0,H)",
        "At the midpoint of the symmetry cut (0,H/2)",
        "On the upper boundary at (L/2,H)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial distribution of external load F",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Calling F an external load in Sec. 2 does not specify its footprint or nodal distribution. The base-case force-array entries are not reproduced in Sec. 3.2.",
      "readings": [
        "Entire resultant applied to one boundary node",
        "Resultant divided equally between two adjacent boundary nodes",
        "Uniform boundary traction over a patch of length 0.05L, normalized to the same resultant"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Direction of external load F",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The direction of F is not stated in the prose or a base-case force listing; its depiction is deferred to Fig. 1(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Vertically downward",
        "Inclined 30 degrees from downward vertical, with an inward horizontal component"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Resultant force applied to the half-model",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 names F without a numerical magnitude. Sec. 3.2 omits the base-case data array. The explicit force values in Sec. 4 belong to different examples.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit resultant applied to the modeled half-beam: F=1",
        "Unit resultant specified for the full beam, giving F=0.5 in the half-model",
        "Resultant F=2 in the same force units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 specifies plane stress but gives no thickness or thickness normalization for the element stiffness. The assumption v_j=1 in Sec. 2 does not explicitly define physical thickness.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t=1",
        "Uniform thickness t=0.1 in the same length units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus E0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 fixes Emin/E0=10^-9. Sec. 3.2 says E0 is stored on line 12, but no numerical value is supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "E0=1, with Emin=10^-9",
        "E0=2 in the same modulus units, with Emin=2*10^-9"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio of the elastic material",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 specifies plane stress and Wachpress shape functions, but supplies no Poisson's ratio for constructing the reference stiffness matrix.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic material with Poisson's ratio 0.3",
        "Isotropic material with Poisson's ratio 0.25",
        "Isotropic material with Poisson's ratio 0"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Mesh associated specifically with Fig. 2(a)",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.4 lists three mesh/radius pairs, while the Fig. 2 caption identifies rows by ft only. Listing order suggests the smallest mesh for panel (a), but the text does not explicitly assign meshes to columns.",
      "readings": [
        "60 x 20 hexagonal elements",
        "120 x 40 hexagonal elements",
        "300 x 100 hexagonal elements"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Hexagonal-grid coordinates, orientation, and staggering",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 describes coordinate-generation lines and refers to another source, but does not provide the coordinate expressions. Counts alone do not determine the spatial grid to reproduce.",
      "readings": [
        "Regular hexagons with upper/lower vertices and alternate rows shifted by half the horizontal pitch",
        "Regular hexagons with left/right vertices and alternate columns shifted by half the vertical pitch"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Numerical integration used to construct KE",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 names Wachpress shape functions and plane stress, but neither prints KE nor specifies its integration rule.",
      "readings": [
        "Divide each hexagon into six centroid-to-edge triangles and use three-point Gaussian integration per triangle",
        "Use the same triangular subdivision with seven-point Gaussian integration per triangle"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "OC density move limit",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 says move is defined on line 80, but gives no value or bound formula.",
      "readings": [
        "Maximum density change of 0.2 per iteration",
        "Maximum density change of 0.1 per iteration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "OC update formula and damping",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 calls the method standard optimality criteria, and Sec. 3.3 describes OcC without supplying its formula or damping exponent.",
      "readings": [
        "Before clipping to bounds, update rho by multiplying by (-dc/(lambda*dv))^0.5",
        "Before clipping to bounds, update rho by multiplying by (-dc/(lambda*dv))^0.25"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "OC multiplier-search bracket and accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 mentions the search interval inL but does not give its endpoints, search procedure, or stopping tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Bisection on lambda in [0,10^9], stopping when relative bracket width is at most 10^-3",
        "Bisection on lambda in [0,10^6], stopping when relative bracket width is at most 10^-6"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization convergence criterion",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 says change monitors convergence and termination, but does not define its norm or threshold.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when the maximum absolute density change is at most 0.01",
        "Stop when the maximum absolute density change is at most 0.001",
        "Stop when the RMS density change is at most 0.01"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Maximum optimization iterations",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 mentions maxiter on line 80 without supplying its value or the iteration count used for Fig. 2(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Maximum 200 iterations",
        "Maximum 1000 iterations"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
